loop.top3_why: Candidate C uses a plain mean over the nine most consistently ranked models (pool3). The weighted inverse‑error strategies (A and B) achieve a marginally lower overall validation score but rely on a single weighting scheme that may overfit to the limited three‑window validation set, especially given the high error correlation and ranking instability noted in the diagnosis. loop.top3_why_not: A and B have higher per‑window errors in the second window and rely on a weighting that can amplify correlated model errors. Thus they are less preferable than the stable mean strategy.
